scope: Full 321-case Unity PlayMode run followed by one unchanged-source isolated retry; the initial full run remains failed

fullRun.scope: Completed full Unity TestRunnerApi PlayMode suite in the separate source-only validation checkout
fullRun.runner: Unity TestRunnerApi official mode-wide PlayMode filter
fullRun.startTimestampSource: XML test-run start-time; RunStarted callback missing

callbackRecovery.scope: Collector reattached after PlayMode lifecycle; authoritative RunFinished tree supplies every result, including earlier tests. No new test execution started.
callbackRecovery.limitation: RunStarted was not captured after PlayMode lifecycle callback loss. The same run's authoritative RunFinished tree and XML supply all 321 results; this is not a new execution.

runIdBinding.basis: All available records come from one explicitly selected task-local execution directory; discovery and completed names, queue/attachment chronology, authoritative result UTC and XML UTC are cross-checked. The collector requires a fresh output directory.
runIdBinding.limitation: The current result/started schema does not carry the official runId. No missing runId is invented; same-folder chronology and the 321-name equality link those records to queued.json.

limitations: This summary is not another Unity test run. Only the explicitly selected completed API attempt is covered.
The official runId is recorded in queued.json; the schema linkage and any missing start callback are disclosed above.
XML UTC fields have one-second precision. When RunStarted is missing, its start time is taken from XML, never fabricated.
No standalone Windows player execution, APK installation or Android-device gameplay is asserted.
Raw names, output, stack traces, absolute checkout paths and user storage contents are omitted.

isolatedRetry.timestampSource: Actual Unity XML test-run UTC fields; the CLI start invocation contains no timestamp or runId
isolatedRetry.limitation: The asynchronous invocation's initial zero counts are not results. Its selected name/mode and the actual completed JSON/XML case link the retry; no missing timestamp or runId is fabricated.

sourceIdentity.evidenceKind: Post-run source identity check and a fresh read-only rehash during summary generation
sourceIdentity.coordinatorRecord: The fixed manifest was established before regression. The coordinator and validation agent report no product or test edits between the full run and isolated retry; only documentation and tools were edited.
limitations: The run-result JSON files do not contain execution-time source hashes. No retrospective before/after snapshot at each execution boundary is claimed.

The manifest file timestamp is supporting filesystem metadata, not independent proof of historical source contents. The recorded and freshly rehashed source identity is reported separately from the coordinator's unchanged-source record.

failureReview.originalFailure: The full run contains one failed case. Its original failure details remain in the linked JSON and XML evidence.
failureReview.finding: The coordinator reports unchanged test and product code. These artifacts do not establish why the original assertion failed, and a passing isolated retry does not prove that cause is resolved.

limitations: The full run had 320 passes and one failure; the successful isolated retry does not convert it into a 321/321 passing full run.
All 321 distinct cases have a passing result across two executions, not in one execution. The original failed result remains linked and retained.
No source hashes recorded at execution time are invented; the post-run identity evidence and coordinator record have separate scopes.
The original timing-related failure cause remains unconfirmed and may represent a flaky fixture or another transient issue.
This read-only summary is not another Unity test, Windows player run, APK installation or Android-device gameplay check.
Only the affected test's identifier is included; raw stack traces, absolute checkout paths and user storage contents are omitted.
